Definition: Elah, the name of an Edomite, of four Israelites, and also of a place in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Elah is the name of an Edomite, of four Israelites, and also of a place in Palestine. In Genesis 36:41, the text says "duke Elah." The life behind the name is told on the Elah People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Elah matters because God knows His people by name, and Elah is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
